summary: DeSaulnier sponsored the Block the Bombs Act and voted against most Israel military-aid packages, calling Gaza “unacceptable by any standards of humanity.” Yet he voted yes on a January 2026 appropriations bill carrying $3.3 billion for Israel and against cutting $500 million in Israeli missile-defense funding. CAIR Action endorsement and JStreetPAC backing sit alongside a California Jewish Democrats “Support” rating and earlier IHRA-tied college-restriction votes, a record that condemns the war while stopping short of severing U.S. military ties.
